title: Rohit Sharma on Mumbai vs rest debate: 'I don't believe in this edge'

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Veteran Tamil poet Vairamuthu's Jnanpith Award win has ignited controversy. Singer Chinmayi Sripada, who previously accused him of sexual misconduct, voiced strong criticism, questioning the accolades from industry figures like Rajinikanth and Kamal Haasan. She highlighted the impact of #MeToo allegations and the silencing of victims, expressing disappointment over the recognition.
title: Chinmayi Sripada slams Vairamuthu’s Jnanpith honour

author: TNN
description: Around 100 stray dogs were allegedly poisoned and killed in Kishtapur village, Mancherial district, on the alleged orders of the village sarpanch and gram panchayat secretary. A complaint filed on March 10 led to an FIR after intervention from the DGP. Animal activists are demanding exhumation and post-mortems for justice.
title: 100 stray dogs poisoned to death, buried near river in Telangana

author: GITESH SHELKE
description: A group of about 150 individuals is being sought by Saswad police. They are accused of attacking 14 men near a lake at Askarwadi. The victims were observing Ramzan Iftar when the assault occurred. The attackers reportedly used sticks, sharp weapons, and stones. The injured men received medical treatment. Police are reviewing CCTV footage to identify the suspects.
title: 'Arrived on 100 bikes': 150 attack 14 men from Kondhwa during Iftar near Askarwadi

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: The ongoing war between the United States, Israel, and Iran highlights the growing role of inexpensive drones. First-person-view (FPV) drones, originally for recreation, are now battlefield weapons. These agile drones offer precise strikes at a low cost, challenging expensive air defense systems. Their widespread use signals a shift in modern warfare tactics.
title: FPV drones enter Iran vs US-Israel war: All about the low-cost ‘kamikaze’ weapons

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: India's Sanju Samson lauded opening partner Abhishek Sharma, calling their partnership 'fire and fire' and a natural Kerala-Punjabi blend. Samson highlighted Abhishek's bravery and composure, enjoying their strong on and off-field camaraderie.  Their explosive partnership in the T20 World Cup final propelled India to a record third title win.
title: Indian players were 'jealous' of Abhishek Sharma: Sanju Samson opens up

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: Former Pakistan captain Rashid Latif has sharply criticised the Pakistan Cricket Board following the team's T20 World Cup exit. He contrasted Pakistan's tendency to falter before knockouts with India's consistent success in major tournaments, attributing India's winning habit to years of hard work. Latif also labeled the PCB a 'weak board' over alleged contract mismanagement.

description: US President Donald Trump indicated potential further strikes on Iran's Kharg Island oil export hub, stating previous actions "totally demolished" most of its oil infrastructure. title: ‘Just for fun’: Trump signals fresh US strikes on Iran’s Kharg Island

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: Amidst Middle East crisis concerns, India assures stable fertiliser supply for the upcoming Kharif season. Government data reveals urea stocks are higher than last year, with DAP and NPK reserves also significantly boosted. Domestic production is expected to exceed consumption, and global tenders have been issued to ensure uninterrupted shipments.
title: ‘More than adequate stocks’: Govt assures no fertiliser shortage amid Middle East crisis

author: RAJ SHEKHAR JHA
description: Two Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorists, Sajjad and Shabbir Ahmed Lone, previously incarcerated in Delhi, have resurfaced as 'most wanted' operatives. Fleeing to Pakistan, Lone is now orchestrating terror plots from Bangladesh with ISI backing, while Sajjad leads the LeT proxy TRF from Rawalpindi. Both are considered extremely dangerous.
title: Out of Tihar Jail, Sajjad Gul, Shabbir turn India’s ‘most-wanted’ LeT operatives again

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: In the electrifying trailer for 'Ustaad Bhagat Singh', Pawan Kalyan steps back into the spotlight, portraying a formidable police officer. This film promises to be a rollercoaster of high-octane action, expertly mingling intense drama with vibrant romantic moments featuring Sreeleela and Raashii Khanna.
title: 'Ustaad Bhagat Singh' trailer: Pawan Kalyan returns as action cop

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: A drone strike ignited a major fire at Erbil's Lanaz refinery in northern Iraq on Saturday, leading to a halt in operations. description: A 24-year-old man, HIV-positive since birth, was arrested for attempting to murder a relative by injecting her with his infected blood. He allegedly acted after she refused to marry him upon discovering his condition. The incident occurred at her flat, and she fell ill the next day. Police are awaiting medical results.

author: PRANTIK PRABAL ROY
description: The NHL handed Radko Gudas a five-game suspension after a kneeing play left Auston Matthews with a season-ending MCL tear. The incident also revived anger tied to Sidney Crosby’s earlier knee injury, which forced him to miss Canada’s Olympic gold medal game. Both the Pittsburgh Penguins and Toronto Maple Leafs now face major lineup gaps, and many fans believe the punishment does little to reflect the long-term damage caused by the collisions.

description: The escalating US-Iran conflict threatens the 2026 FIFA World Cup, with Iran's participation in doubt following controversial statements and their own reported intent to withdraw. FIFA faces a complex dilemma, balancing security concerns and potential sanctions against Iran's right to withdraw due to force majeure.

description: Delhi experienced a welcome rainfall on Sunday morning, offering a break from the recent heat. Temperatures are expected to hover around 27-29°C, with a further chance of light rain and thunderstorms on March 18. While a temporary dip in maximum temperatures is anticipated, a gradual rise is forecast for the coming days, with night temperatures likely to remain mild.

author: TNN
description: A 17-year-old girl was allegedly drugged, sexually assaulted, and filmed at a Mount Abu New Year's party by a 14-year-old acquaintance and a 26-year-old man. The victim discovered the assault months later when a video of the incident went viral on social media. Police have arrested the man and are holding the minor.

author: NIMESH KHAKHARIYA
description: A young couple's disappearance in Gujarat has been revealed as a brutal honor killing. The 19-year-old woman's father allegedly orchestrated their murders because he opposed their marriage. Police recovered the decomposed bodies from a well, leading to the arrest of the father and his nephew.
title: Honour killing: Couple murdered by woman’s father, cousin in Gujarat

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: India's T20 World Cup champions visited a Mumbai temple, continuing celebrations despite a debate sparked by Kirti Azad's remarks questioning religious inclusivity. Azad argued the victory belonged to all Indians, not a specific faith. Harbhajan Singh and Gautam Gambhir defended the team's actions, emphasizing the magnitude of their achievement.
title: After Azad’s criticism, SKY, Gambhir visit temple with T20 WC - Watch

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Akshay Kumar shared his perspective on paparazzi, stating that photographers earning a living by clicking him and his family is not an invasion of privacy. He believes that if people stop recognizing him, that would be a genuine concern for an actor. Kumar views it as a part of his profession, not a hazard.
title: Akshay Kumar reacts to being clicked with family after Jaya Bachchan’s comment on paps

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Iran's foreign minister stated the Strait of Hormuz remains open to all nations except the US and Israel, following US airstrikes. He asserted that while many ships avoid the passage due to security concerns, this is not Iran's doing. Meanwhile, former President Trump urged global powers to send warships to ensure the strait's openness.

Selector Aaqib Javed admitted the situation is serious but not catastrophic, emphasizing the team's capability.
